fields.claim: The faults cluster on streets where the works notice names no contact point, so repair requests are lost.

evidence_refs.supports: Shows which notices carry a contact point and which do not.

fields.uncertainty: The register covers one year only.
assumptions: I assume the register lists every notice issued.
fields.hypothesis: Missing contact points on notices may explain why repair requests are not answered.
fields.mechanism: A notice without a contact point sends residents to a general line, where the request is not tied to a street.
fields.test_that_would_disprove_it: If streets with a contact point show the same delay, the notice is not the cause.

fields.claim: A change to the notice template falls under the Head of Road Works and needs no new money.

evidence_refs.supports: Maps road repair notices to the Head of Road Works.

fields.uncertainty: I did not check whether a council vote is also needed.
assumptions: I assume the template is an operational document.
fields.constraint: The notice template is set by the Head of Road Works under the topic table for road repair.
fields.source_ref: Fiktiva City topic table, road-repair entry (invented fixture).
fields.recheck_condition: If the topic table is amended.

fields.claim: The works notice register shows which notices name a contact point.

evidence_refs.supports: Lists every notice and its contact field.

fields.uncertainty: The register may lag by a few weeks.
fields.source_description: The Fiktiva City works notice register, published monthly.
fields.claim_supported: Of the listed notices, most have an empty contact field.
fields.what_it_does_not_show: It does not show whether residents called the general line instead.

fields.claim: A later measuring stage needs the same register to be public each month.

evidence_refs.supports: Shows the register is already published monthly.

fields.constraint: Measuring needs a public register; the Head of Road Works controls its publication.
fields.source_ref: Fiktiva City works notice register publication practice (invented fixture).
fields.recheck_condition: If the register stops being published.
